title: Credit Demand is Strong: HSBC's Patrice Altongy
content: With the rise of issuance in Europe and the US and surge in supply, HSBC Americas Head of Debt Capital Markets Patrice Altongy believes credit demand is ‘super strong.’ She explains more with Scarlet Fu on ‘Real Yield.’ (Source: Bloomberg)

title: It Is A Private Market Story: UBS' Matthew Mish
content: UBS Investment Bank Head of Credit Strategy Matthew Mish believes there are emerging signs of deterioration in credit quality making it a private, not public, market concern. He speaks with Scarlet Fu on Real Yield.' (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Thiam Vows to Fight On to Become President of Ivory Coast
content: Former Credit Suisse AG Chief Executive Officer Tidjane Thiam vowed to press ahead with his presidential ambitions in Ivory Coast, even after being barred from next month’s elections in the West African nation.

title: Fitch Cuts Poland Credit Outlook And Warns of Fiscal Risks
content: Fitch Ratings signaled it may lower Poland’s A- credit score as public debt quickly grows and there’s limited prospects for the government to reduce its bulging budget deficit.

title: UniCredit Is Set to Select BNP Paribas to Safeguard Assets

title: Goldman Shifts a Top Private Credit Executive in Bet on Mideast
